title: Carabiner MCP configuration
description: Schema for .carabiner/mcp.jsonc — the canonical MCP server list

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file.

mcpServers.description: Map of MCP server definitions keyed by server name.

command.description: Executable to run. Required for stdio servers.

env.description: Environment variables set before launching the server.

url.description: Server URL. Required for http and sse servers.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with each request. Used by http and sse servers.
